u0: At the start of the mission you have not yet seen the matching key, so no progress toward the locked door is known. Explore the rooms, especially the left-column rooms, looking for the key; spotting it will latch the key-found condition and advance the task.
u1: The matching key has been seen and is now located, but you are not yet carrying it (or not yet carrying a key of the locked door's color). Next objective: go to the key, pick it up, and confirm you hold the matching key to advance.
u2: You are carrying the matching key. Next objective: reach the locked door guarding the target ball's room, toggle it open with the key, and hold the door open to advance.
u3: The locked door is open and you still hold the matching key. Next objective: drop the key so your hands are free, while keeping the door open, to reach the state ready to grab the ball; if the door becomes closed, return to carrying the key and reopen it.
u4: The door is open and the key is dropped, so your hands are free. Next objective: enter the target room and pick up the mission's ball; picking it up completes the mission. If the door gets closed, recover to the carrying-key-and-open-door state.
u5: The mission's ball has been picked up; the episode is complete and this is the final success state. There is nothing further to pursue.
